title: my near death experience and an odd coincidence
content: Hello all! So, I was just recounting my near death experience to my grandmother, who was actually the adult in the situation that kept me from dying, and she mentioned an interesting detail involving a blonde boy. For context, I had my NDE around the ages of 3-5. My folks don't remember my exact age, just that I was a very young child and it was prior to my little sister being born. I have posted about it in more detail, but TL;DR I was running an extremely high fever (around 104 F, enough to kill a child that age) and was, as far as the adults around me could tell, hallucinating. I vividly remember stepping out of the house and into what I've always called the White Room. I saw two kids there in my age range, one mixed girl with dark curly hair, and a white boy with blonde hair and light eyes. I later talked to a man in a suit that asked if i was "ready to go" and i said no, that my grandmother would miss me. He then pushed me by my shoulders and i fell out of the room. I don't actually recall anything after the white room, but my grandmother who picked me up from my aunt's house and drove me to the doctor, remembers tearing out of the driveway, turning on to the state highway and seeing a blonde boy playing in the ditch. The area that my aunt lived was about 30 minutes from the nearest town. They were actually the only houses for the next mile or so at the time, other than my other aunt who at the time had no children. The area was entirely just hunting and pine tree farms, and a small cattle farm that was only used half the year for grazing. My grandmother came to a stop and asked the kid where his parents were, and what his name was. He was around my age, and kids don't need to play near any road, let alone a logging highway. According to her, he didnt reply at first, just tried opening the truck door to get inside. He didn't seem hurt or rushed, in fact he was extremely calm. My grandma had the doors locked, and told him that she couldn't take him anywhere, and asked what his name was and who his parents were. At that point he finally replied, and just said "she's sick. She'll be okay though." And walked into the woods. So she left. "I had a sick grandbaby in the back, i couldn't worry about other people's kids," was her response to me being like "you let a random child wander around a logging site? And you didn't tell anyone?" She never saw the boy again, but got really quiet when I mentioned that I've seen a blonde man in my dreams consistently since I could remember my dreams. If you're wondering how this relates to the mall world, i genuinely think that my NDE was my entrance to seeing that side of reality. And with a blonde man appearing about half the time I go to the mall world, and with how many people have seen men in suits? Maybe coincidence. But it just feels too on the nose to be random.
